summary.zh: 写清事故时间线、根因和改进动作
summary.en: Write blameless postmortems with timelines and action items.

description.zh: 按免追责复盘的结构整理事故时间线、根因分析和后续改进行动，产出能落地的结论。事故复盘、定期回顾，或完善故障响应流程时使用。
description.en: Structures the incident timeline, root cause analysis and follow-up actions into a blameless postmortem people can act on. Use it for incident reviews or when improving how a team responds to failures.
